buyer_intent_queries: prefab room addition for existing house

segment_contamination_dimensions: Standalone independent prefabricated structures (bunkhouses, portable houses, container homes, log homes, wooden houses, steel houses, prefabricated guest houses, modular cottages, prefabricated huts) — these are complete self-contained buildings for buyers who need a new independent structure, not an addition to an existing home; names or alt-name entries that describe a standalone habitable unit rather than an addition/extension to an existing structure are blocked to prevent attracting that buyer segment

Temporary or site-use portable structures (guard huts, PVC guard huts, bunk house offices, prefab steel bunk houses, MS bunkhouses, portable huts) — these target industrial/site-deployment buyers seeking temporary accommodation units, a fundamentally different buyer persona and use context from residential homeowners seeking a permanent room addition
